svg.title: The MARS agent engine: one turn, as the code runs it
svg.desc: A sequence diagram of one agent turn across six lifelines: caller, agent loop, checks, tools, record and model. The caller calls run_session; for each turn, at most 20, the loop checks should_stop and pending_input, calls complete on the model port and receives a ModelResponse; for each proposed tool call it calls validate_tool_call, then the approver, then make_cache_key, then the tool function, which returns a ToolResult; it records the call and saves the manifest, and appends a ToolResultBlock for the next turn. The session ends with SessionFinished, whose outcome is end_turn, max_turns, interrupted or error. Beside it, specification cards list the model port's schema dialects, the 7 protocol fault types, the approval risk tags and decisions, the ToolResult envelope, the MCP path's strict validation and owned worker per call, and the benchmark's tool plane and graders.
svg.text: a fault: error result, tool not called
